description: The plot illustrates how Pass@1 Rate (%) varies with the number of reasoning steps for two models. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Reasoning Steps,” uses a linear scale, and shows values from 5 to 40 with ticks at 5, 10, 20, and 40. The y-axis is labeled “Pass@1 Rate (%),” uses a linear scale from 0 to 100, with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100. One line corresponds to GPT-4o, drawn in medium blue with circular markers connected by a solid line; it increases from 6.5 at 5 steps to 32.3 at 10 steps, then to 77.4 at 20 steps, and reaches 83.9 at 40 steps. The other line corresponds to Claude-3.5-Sonnet, drawn in a lighter blue with “x” markers connected by a solid line; it rises from 19.4 at 5 steps to 38.7 at 10 steps, then to 87.1 at 20 steps, and ends at 89.2 at 40 steps.
